description.zh: 阿里云容器服务Kubernetes版的Kubernetes集群的ID。
description.en: The ID of the Container Service for Kubernetes (ACK) cluster.

description.zh: ARMS支持的软件缩写。可选值（不区分大小写）：`ASM`、`IoT`和`Flink`。
description.en: The abbreviation of the software that is supported by Application Real-Time Monitoring Service (ARMS). Valid values (case-insensitive): `ASM`, `IoT`, and `Flink`.
